newsitem.title: GERMANY: Audi says no decision yet on sick pay.
newsitem.headline: Audi says no decision yet on sick pay.

text.p: German luxury carmaker Audi AG said it has not yet decided whether to implement a new sick-pay policy that a number of German companies have decided to start on October 1.
Audi chief executive officer Herbert Demel told journalists at the Stuttgart press club late on Thursday that the topic was under discussion.
He said one possibility at Audi, a unit of Volkswagen AG, would be to not cut sick-day payments but instead to use holiday time to offset lost working hours.
The new law approved by Bonn calls allows for sick pay to be cut to 80 percent of gross wages from the current level of 100 percent.
Many German companies, including industrial group Daimler-Benz AG, have said they will implement the new policy beginning next week but unions have threatened to stage protest strikes.
